name: Lunar Relay
description:
A research cluster login node on a lunar base has gone quiet. Connect to the host, investigate its local state, and recover the challenge flag while verifying elevated access. The box runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. SSH credentials are provided below.

---

**Access** — SSH `cosmonaut@172.20.0.141`, password `Luna-Relay-6`

tasks.name: Recover the root signal
tasks.description: The lunar research cluster's login node is behaving strangely. Investigate the host and recover its challenge flag, verifying you gained elevated access. It runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. SSH credentials are provided in the access details.
hints: Treat this as a host investigation: inventory what the account can run and inspect permissions on the box.
Pay close attention to privileged launchers and the files or commands they rely on; one local arrangement allows a general root context.
The cluster maintenance launcher runs `/opt/lunar/rotate.sh` with elevated credentials. Replace its contents with a root-shell handoff, then invoke the launcher and inspect the root-only evidence.
